summary_1line: Krishna prepares at dawn and proceeds with grandeur to the Kuru court to attempt peace between Kauravas and Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: At dawn Krishna offers libations to the sacred fire and worships the rising sun after his bath.
Krishna, wearing the Kaustubha gem, mounts his resounding chariot while conchs and cymbals sound and warriors assemble around him.
Crowds fill balconies and rooftops of the city as Krishna’s grand procession of chariots, elephants, and soldiers moves toward the Kuru court.
